name: Volatility compression breakout (IV-confirmed)
description: QR-10 (W30). Realised volatility has compressed (20-session below 60-session) and the stock breaks its prior 20-session high on volume, while its options price the move as calm (ATM IV rank below the parameter) -- breakouts out of quiet ranges before the options market reprices. Only F&O stocks qualify (dv_iv_rank is None otherwise). Exit on a close below the prior 10-session low or when IV rank spikes.
